### Bible Pathway - September 12
Author: Bible Pathway Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathway-sept-12-2013.html
Passage: Ezekiel 40:5
Points:
- Readers often dismiss Ezekiel's detailed architectural measurements as dry and irrelevant, missing valuable spiritual instruction.
- The man holding the measuring rod carefully verifies that every part of the temple conforms to God's exact pattern.
- Just as a rod measures physical structures, Scripture functions as a spiritual measuring tool to discern our hearts and thoughts.
- Regular prayer and Bible study help believers evaluate their daily conduct and align their lives with God's will.
- Yielding to the Word allows the Lord to separate us from ungodly influences and build us according to His design.
